# docs/memory/workflow/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php from the frontmatter of each file, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

Project overview, owner rules, decisions already made, git and branches, sandbox and dev machine.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Read the decisions list before writing any audit finding or proposing a cleanup: a listed place is not a finding, and an entry you doubt is asked about, never changed (`decisions-made.md`).
- Work in the working mode: claim a task with a draft PR and never an issue, one open PR per session, no stacked branches, light checks, no review chains (`working-mode.md`, `session-checks.md`). When CI is green put the `ready` label on, wait subscribed, never merge `development` into the PR after that, and take the plan's next step once it is merged (`session-lifecycle.md`). Only the merging session merges, in merge trains landed by one fast-forward push (`merge-train.md`, `merge-train-landing.md`); a coordinator per account starts the workers and carries the owner's questions (`coordinator.md`).
- Owner decisions are about the product's behaviour and carry their reason (`decisions-made.md`); a working rule is never written as the owner's decision (`CLAUDE.md`, Fixed rules 6).
- Never edit `changelog.txt` (name the `[NEW]` line or `[SCHEME]` item in the PR body), add translation keys only with `php tools/tr_add.php` (sorted shards in `includes/local/tr/`, never edited by hand), and only append to the open migration file and `init.php`; merge `origin/development` once before the PR goes up (`working-mode.md`, `git-branches-and-shared-files.md`).
- Keep PHP 7.1 working: raising the minimum is the owner's call, and a library may never raise it as a side effect (`project-overview.md`).
- Guard a newer PHP API (`function_exists()`, `PHP_VERSION_ID`) and mark it with `phpcs:ignore` naming the guard; never add a baseline entry for it (`static-analysis.md`).
- Set up a running instance (`tools/setup_sandbox.sh`) only to reproduce a runtime error or for the Bootstrap 6 plan's screenshot rounds, and say in the PR what could not be verified (`sandbox-and-environment.md`).
- Keep area rules in memory only (folder README key rules and topic files, no `.claude/skills`); settle a README conflict with `php tools/memory_index.php` and merge only the key-rules block by hand, never by deleting the README (`owner-rules.md`, `memory-index-key-rules.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->

- decisions-made.md: The decisions list: places reviewed and kept as they are on purpose; how to treat it and who adds to it, then the code and files that look dead or wrong but stay.

- memory-index-key-rules.md: The hand-written key-rules block of each memory folder README, what tools/memory_index.php keeps and regenerates, when it stops with exit 1 and how a merge conflict in a README is settled
- merge-review.md: Rule (2026-10-25): the merging session reviews each PR once, fixes only blocking findings, leaves minor ones (no follow-up issue), digs deeper only for access, payments, SQL, schema
- merge-train-landing.md: How a green merge train lands (2026-10-25): one fast-forward push, GitHub marks the PRs merged and wakes their sessions, no push to PR branches; why not a squash per PR; a red train; the merge queue
- merge-train-tool.md: tools/merge_train.php (#2002): --start (the lock), --list (train order), --build (merge, settle, changelog, push), --land (fast-forward); what it leaves to the merging session
- merge-train.md: Working rule (2026-10-25) for the merging session: one merger, one train at a time, 30-minute windows, rules-only PRs alone, the ready label, one merge commit per PR, one CI run
- merger-wake.md: How the merging session keeps waking (2026-10-26): a 5-minute session cron, an hourly routine that re-creates it after a restart; GitHub events are not relied on
- owner-rules.md: Standing rules from the owner (Erdal) on docs, how changes are recorded, pages, plans, where area rules live (memory; vendor Bootstrap skills aside), language, the mobile app, who edits which notes
- pr-footer-and-trailers.md: Where the "Generated by Claude Code" footer and commit trailers come from, the settings that turn them off, how to write without it, and why only the merging session removes it.
- pre-push-checks.md: git push runs tools/pre_push.sh first (installed when a cloud session starts in the clone): which CI checks it runs on the pushed commit, why, installing it elsewhere, its blind spots, skipping
- project-overview.md: What Pinegrap is, supported PHP range, stack, repo layout (pinegrap/ root), dev-only folders, files never in any branch
- sandbox-and-environment.md: Cloud sandbox (PHP 8.3, no Composer), when and how to run tools/setup_sandbox.sh, the owner's dev machine dev.pinegrap.com and how a linked session updates its checkout
- session-checks.md: Working rule (2026-10-25): how much a session checks before its PR: the tests of its area and what the change touches, a private static-analysis cache, a sandbox only with a reason, no review chains

- unit-test-database-exit.md: A unit test statement that reaches db() ends the whole tools/test.php run with exit code 0 through output_error(); make it throw with pg_error_throws(true), or keep the tested part free of queries
- unit-test-runner.md: tools/test.php: what it loads, which errors fail a test, other PHP versions, code behind a database probe, PHP in its own process (Windows quoting, peak memory), JavaScript under Node
- workflow-lint-and-dependabot.md: The actionlint job (pinned, SHA-256, shellcheck, what its data lacks) and Dependabot for github-actions (read from main, PRs to development, one per major bump)
- working-mode.md: Working rules (2026-10-25) for every session: why they exist, one open PR, no stacked branches, no issues, PR size, queue limit, the changelog through the PR body, docs-only PRs outside the train
